name: BIG BEAR HOME SAUNA
description:
Our largest far infrared sauna for a home is the impressive Big Bear Infrared Sauna. This incredible sauna boasts an amazing amount of far infrared radiant output and can comfortably accommodate four to five people during an infrared sauna session.

Large enough for one person to lie down and stretch out completely on the rear bench. Luxurious and results driven, the Big Bear sauna is the ultimate wellness upgrade to any high-end spa or home.

Eliminate Stress, relieve pain, lose weight and enjoy beautiful, soft skin with the Big Bear Far Infrared Sauna.

Featured Big Bear Sauna shown in optional Red Cedar.
